waivers.reason: Spot is the DONE-LED branch (R6, a few mA) on a 0.6 mm B.Cu strip, not the 2.2 A boost-input path; the 2.2 A budget is net-wide.
Two vias feed R6/LED (a few mA); the net-wide 2.2 A budget does not apply to this branch.
F.Cu GND sliver beside the USB-A J4 THT pads; GND return from J4 goes through its THT pads into the B.Cu GND plane, which is the parallel full-width path.
U1 exposed pad fits 4 thermal vias (0.5 mm pitch limit with pad pitch), the fifth does not fit; 4 vias carry the charger return (<=1.5 A worst case) at 0.5 A each=2 A.

Model floor for a 2-layer board is ~55 C/W so 1.1 W worst case (5 V in, 3 V cell, 1.5 A) cannot reach 40 C rise; GND copper already saturates the model (645 mm2). BQ24074 has internal 125 C thermal regulation that folds back charge current; typical dissipation is lower.
